title: nauclea annamensis
intro: Nauclea annamensis, commonly known as Vietnamese timut, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to aid in the treatment of fever, inflammation, and various infections. The therapeutic actions of Nauclea annamensis include antimalarial, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds. Research has identified several bioactive constituents of this plant, including timutine, timutol, and timutone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
